description.value:
Iconic EQ ROF 1 Heavy Melee Weapon (w/ Bladesmith [Volatile]). All Attacks with it also have the effect of Incendiary Ammunition [Bladesmith]. As an Action, it can be revved up to function as an EQ One-Handed Very Heavy Melee Weapon that ablates 2 additional SP (3 SP Total) until it is dropped, stowed, or revved down as an Action. While revved, if this weapon’s user rolls a 1 during their Attack Check, the motor fails and it automatically revs down. Can accept an additional Weapon Mod (1 Total, as it already has one, Bladesmith).

Variant of: Cut-O-Matic
Category: Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Class: Heavy Melee
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
